limitations.note: The rewrite registered `valid_b` but gated it on `valid_a`, so it suppresses the expected assertion when the clock samples `cnt == 5` during an input stall.
Tying `ready_a` high removed its original reset and startup behavior, allowing a bit to be accepted on the first clock after reset release when the original design would only raise `ready_a`.

The test exercised a stall after five bits but explicitly expected `valid_b` to stay low, encoding the rewrite’s behavior instead of checking that the registered output follows `cnt == 5` during the stall.
